messages.content: Follow the production contract exactly. Return valid JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
The operator tests one subsystem, replaces a failed component, and continues testing the same subsystem.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit.
SPLIT only for a major time/location/state reset or a transition from the main ongoing phase into distinct terminal resolution.
Continuous work in the same phase remains together.

Choose: SPLIT or KEEP_TOGETHER.
Return JSON with keys decision and reason.
